# lostcoords-ui

Rails rendering helpers with semantic HTML, native attributes and browser interactions.

Install and styling: https://ui.lostcoords.com/installation.html
Theming: https://ui.lostcoords.com/theming.html
API JSON: https://ui.lostcoords.com/api.json

Tailwind CSS v4 is required. Install the gem once; the Rails engine exposes all lc_* helpers without per-component imports.
The engine includes a default light and dark theme. Override CSS variables only as needed. Use class: to merge Tailwind utilities, data: and aria: for native attributes. Block helpers capture Rails ERB.
lc_button_to keeps Rails form, method and CSRF semantics. Each host application's lockfile pins its version.

## Theme colors

Override only the roles you need. Soft status backgrounds are generated automatically. Primary controls actions, links, selection and focus.

- `--background`: Page background
- `--foreground`: Main text and headings
- `--card`: Cards and grouped content
- `--card-foreground`: Text on cards
- `--popover`: Menus, popovers and dialogs
- `--popover-foreground`: Text on menus, popovers and dialogs
- `--primary`: Primary actions, links, selected states and keyboard focus
- `--primary-foreground`: Text and icons on a solid primary background
- `--secondary`: Secondary buttons
- `--secondary-foreground`: Text on secondary buttons
- `--muted`: Subtle backgrounds: badges, code, skeletons, table headers
- `--muted-foreground`: Secondary text, hints and placeholders
- `--accent`: Hovered rows, menu items and inline code
- `--accent-foreground`: Text on accent backgrounds
- `--destructive`: Errors and destructive actions
- `--success`: Successful actions and positive feedback
- `--warning`: Warnings and items needing attention
- `--border`: Dividers and outlines
- `--input`: Input and toggle fills
- `--ring`: Keyboard focus ring; unset, it follows --primary

## lc_checkbox

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/checkbox.html#lc_checkbox

```ruby
lc_checkbox(label, name: nil, value: "1", checked: false, unchecked_value: "0", hint: nil, card: false, **attributes, &block)
```

Checkboxes: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/checkbox.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related do %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Email me about comments", name: "notify[comments]", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Weekly digest", name: "notify[digest]", hint: "A summary every Monday." %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Product news", name: "notify[news]", disabled: true %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_radio

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/radio.html#lc_radio

```ruby
lc_radio(label, name:, value:, checked: false, hint: nil, card: false, **attributes, &block)
```

Radio group: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/radio.html

```erb
<%= lc_choice_group legend: "Plan", hint: "You can change plans at any time." do %>
  <%= lc_radio "Free", name: "plan", value: "free", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_radio "Team", name: "plan", value: "team", hint: "Shared projects and roles." %>
  <%= lc_radio "Enterprise", name: "plan", value: "enterprise" %>
<% end %>
```

Cards: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/radio.html

```erb
<%= lc_choice_group legend: "Plan", class: "w-full max-w-md" do %>
  <%= lc_radio "Free", name: "my-component-plan", value: "free", hint: "Up to 3 projects.", card: true %>
  <%= lc_radio "Team", name: "my-component-plan", value: "team", hint: "Shared projects and roles.", card: true, checked: true do %>
    <%= lc_text "$12 per member, per month", size: :caption, tone: :muted %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_radio "Enterprise", name: "my-component-plan", value: "enterprise", hint: "SSO and audit logs.", card: true %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_switch

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/switch.html#lc_switch

```ruby
lc_switch(label, name: nil, value: "1", checked: false, unchecked_value: "0", hint: nil, **attributes)
```

Switches: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/switch.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related do %>
  <%= lc_switch "Public project", name: "project[public]", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_switch "Allow comments", name: "project[comments]", hint: "Members can comment on pages." %>
<% end %>
```

Tabs: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/tabs.html

```erb
<%= lc_tabs id: "my-component-tabs", label: "Project", class: "w-full" do |tabs| %>
  <% tabs.panel "Overview" do %>
    <%= lc_text "Pages, members and recent changes." %>
  <% end %>
  <% tabs.panel "Activity" do %>
    <%= lc_text "Nothing new this week.", tone: :muted %>
  <% end %>
  <% tabs.panel "Settings" do %>
    <%= lc_switch "Public project", name: "project[public]" %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Vertical, with manual activation: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/tabs.html

```erb
<%= lc_tabs id: "my-component-settings", label: "Settings", orientation: :vertical, activation: :manual, class: "w-full" do |tabs| %>
  <% tabs.panel "Profile" do %>
    <%= lc_text "Name, photo and contact details." %>
  <% end %>
  <% tabs.panel "Notifications" do %>
    <%= lc_switch "Email me about mentions", name: "settings[mentions]" %>
  <% end %>
  <% tabs.panel "Billing" do %>
    <%= lc_text "Plan, invoices and payment method.", tone: :muted %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

```ruby
lc_choice_group(legend:, id: nil, hint: nil, error: nil, **attributes, &block)
```

```erb
<%= lc_choice_group legend: "Plan", hint: "You can change plans at any time." do %>
  <%= lc_radio "Free", name: "plan", value: "free", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_radio "Team", name: "plan", value: "team", hint: "Shared projects and roles." %>
  <%= lc_radio "Enterprise", name: "plan", value: "enterprise" %>
<% end %>
```

```erb
<%= lc_choice_group legend: "Plan", class: "w-full max-w-md" do %>
  <%= lc_radio "Free", name: "my-component-plan", value: "free", hint: "Up to 3 projects.", card: true %>
  <%= lc_radio "Team", name: "my-component-plan", value: "team", hint: "Shared projects and roles.", card: true, checked: true do %>
    <%= lc_text "$12 per member, per month", size: :caption, tone: :muted %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_radio "Enterprise", name: "my-component-plan", value: "enterprise", hint: "SSO and audit logs.", card: true %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_code_block

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/code_block.html#lc_code_block

```ruby
lc_code_block(source, id:, language: nil, title: nil, label: nil, max_lines: 10, **attributes, &block)
```

Plain source: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/code_block.html

```erb
<%= lc_code_block "def hello(name)\n  puts name\nend", id: "my-component-ruby", language: :ruby, label: "Ruby greeting", class: "w-full" %>
```

With a filename: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/code_block.html

```erb
<%= lc_code_block "def hello(name)\n  puts name\nend", id: "my-component-file", language: :ruby, title: "app/helpers/greeting_helper.rb", label: "Greeting helper", class: "w-full" %>
```

Collapsible source: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/code_block.html

```erb
<%= lc_code_block (1..15).map { |number| "puts #{number}" }.join("\n"), id: "my-component-long", language: :ruby, label: "Long Ruby snippet", max_lines: 5, class: "w-full" %>
```

## lc_collapsible

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/collapsible.html#lc_collapsible

```ruby
lc_collapsible(title:, open: false, **attributes, &block)
```

Expandable content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/collapsible.html

```erb
<%= lc_collapsible class: "w-full", title: "Can I use my own colors?" do %>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Yes. Override the default theme values in your application stylesheet.</p>
<% end %>
```

## lc_copy_button

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/copy_button.html#lc_copy_button

```ruby
lc_copy_button(label = nil, value: nil, source: nil, copied_label: nil, error_label: nil, reset_after: 2000, icon_only: false, variant: :secondary, size: :md, **attributes)
```

Motion feedback: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_copy_button "Copy link", value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", copied_label: "Link copied", reset_after: 2500 %>
<%= lc_copy_button "Copy link", value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", icon_only: true, variant: :ghost %>
```

Labels, icons and disabled controls: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/copy_button.html

```erb
<%= lc_copy_button value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", variant: :primary %>
<%= lc_copy_button "Copy link", value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", copied_label: "Link copied" %>
<%= lc_copy_button "Copy link", value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", icon_only: true, variant: :ghost %>
<%= lc_copy_button value: "Unavailable", disabled: true %>
```

Copy from an element: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/copy_button.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related, class: "w-full max-w-md" do %>
  <%= lc_field label: "Share link", id: "my-component-link" do |field| %>
    <%= lc_input value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", **field %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_copy_button "Copy current link", source: "my-component-link", copied_label: "Link copied", class: "w-full" %>
  <%= lc_text "Edit the link, then copy it. The button reads the current value each time.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
<% end %>
```

Translated labels: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/copy_button.html

```erb
<% I18n.with_locale(:ja) do %>
  <%= lc_copy_button value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", lang: "ja" %>
<% end %>
<% I18n.with_locale(:es) do %>
  <%= lc_copy_button value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", lang: "es" %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_description_list

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/description_list.html#lc_description_list

```ruby
lc_description_list(**attributes, &block)
list.item(term, detail = nil, **attributes, &block)
```

Details: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/description_list.html

```erb
<%= lc_card class: "w-full" do |card| %>
  <%= card.header title: "Workspace" %>
  <%= lc_description_list do |list| %>
    <%= list.item "Owner", "Ada Baker" %>
    <%= list.item "Plan" do %>
      <%= lc_badge "Team", tone: :primary %>
    <% end %>
    <%= list.item "Created", "March 4, 2026" %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_dialog

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html#lc_dialog

```ruby
lc_dialog(id:, title:, description: nil, trigger: lc_t("lostcoords.ui.dialog.trigger"), kind: :modal, detents: "fit", **attributes, &block)
dialog.footer(**attributes, &block)
dialog.close(label = nil, variant: :secondary, **attributes)
```

Modal: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html

```erb
<%= lc_dialog id: "my-component-dialog", title: "Create project", description: "Projects group pages and members.", trigger: "New project" do |dialog| %>
  <form method="dialog" class="flex flex-col gap-inset">
    <%= lc_field label: "Project name", id: "my-component-dialog-name" do |field| %>
      <%= lc_input name: "project[name]", **field %>
    <% end %>
    <%= dialog.footer do %>
      <%= dialog.close %>
      <%= lc_button "Create project", type: :submit %>
    <% end %>
  </form>
<% end %>
```

Mobile dialog: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html

```erb
<%= lc_dialog id: "my-component-sheet", title: "Workspace details", trigger: "Open mobile dialog", detents: "fit" do %>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Drag the handle down to dismiss.</p>
  <%= lc_field label: "Workspace", id: "my-component-workspace" do |field| %>
    <%= lc_input value: "Design studio", **field %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Mobile height options: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html

```erb
<%= lc_dialog id: "my-component-sheet", title: "Notes", detents: "medium large" do %>
  <%= lc_textarea name: "notes", rows: 8, aria: { label: "Notes" }, placeholder: "Write something…" %>
<% end %>
```

Compact dialog: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/dialog.html

```erb
<%= lc_dialog id: "my-component-context", title: "Quick details", trigger: "Open compact dialog", kind: :context do %>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">A compact dialog for a short, focused task.</p>
<% end %>
```

## lc_emoji_picker

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/emoji.html#lc_emoji_picker

```ruby
lc_emoji_picker(form:, field:, label:, catalog_url:, value: nil, quick: [], recent: [], recent_scope: nil, auto_submit: false, **attributes)
```

Emoji picker: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/emoji.html

```erb
<%= fields_for :project do |form| %>
  <%= lc_emoji_picker form: form, field: :emoji, value: "✨", quick: %w[🥝 🍣 🍜 ☕], label: "Choose an emoji", catalog_url: "/emoji-catalog.html" %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_form_with

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/field.html#lc_form_with

```ruby
lc_form_with(**options, &block)
```

Form builder: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/field.html

```erb
<%= lc_form_with model: DocsProject.invalid_example, url: "#", class: "flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-content" do |form| %>
  <%= form.field :name, hint: "Shown to members." %>
  <%= form.field :email, as: :email_field %>
  <%= form.switch :public, hint: "Anyone with the link can view." %>
  <%= form.submit "Save project" %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_icon

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html#lc_icon

```ruby
lc_icon(name, variant: :outline, options: {}, path_options: {})
```

Custom icons and content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/button.html

```erb
<%= lc_button variant: :secondary do %>
  <%= lc_icon "arrow-down-tray", options: {
    "aria-hidden": true,
    "data-icon": "inline-start"
  } %>
  Download report
<% end %>

<%= lc_button disabled: true, aria: { busy: true } do %>
  <%= lc_spinner size: :sm, label: nil,
      data: { icon: "inline-start" } %>
  Loading report…
<% end %>
```

## lc_stack

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html#lc_stack

```ruby
lc_stack(gap: :content, **attributes, &block)
```

Text styles: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<div class="grid gap-5">
  <%= lc_heading "Weekend in Kyoto", level: 2, size: :title %>
  <%= lc_heading "Shared expenses", level: 3, size: :heading %>
  <%= lc_heading "Dinner with friends", level: 4, size: :subheading %>
  <%= lc_text do %>Use <code>lc_stack</code> to keep related content together.<% end %>
  <%= lc_text "Add a receipt or a short note for your group.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
  <%= lc_text "Updated a few minutes ago", size: :caption, tone: :muted %>
</div>
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>
  <%= lc_section title: "Recent expenses", actions: capture { lc_button("Add expense", icon: "plus", size: :sm) } do %>
    <%= lc_card do %>
      <%= lc_inline class: "flex-nowrap justify-between" do %>
        <%= lc_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= lc_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= lc_card do %>
      <%= lc_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= lc_card do %>
      <%= lc_inline do %>
        <%= lc_avatar "AK", class: "bg-primary" %>
        <%= lc_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= lc_text "Alex Kim" %>
          <%= lc_text "Joined today", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Responsive containers: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_container do %>
  <%= lc_stack gap: :section do %>
    <%= lc_heading "Plan your next trip", level: 2, size: :title %>
    <div class="grid min-w-0 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
      <%= lc_section title: "Travel details", level: 3 do %>
        <%= lc_card do %>
          <%= lc_stack do %>
            <%= lc_text "Kyoto weekend", size: :body %>
            <%= lc_text "Keep shared costs and travel notes together.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
            <%= lc_inline do %>
              <%= lc_button "Invite friends", size: :sm %>
              <%= lc_button "View itinerary", variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
            <% end %>
          <% end %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
      <%= lc_section title: "Shared costs", level: 3 do %>
        <%= lc_card do %>
          <%= lc_text "No expenses yet", size: :body %>
        <% end %>
      <% end %>
    </div>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Checkboxes: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/checkbox.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related do %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Email me about comments", name: "notify[comments]", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Weekly digest", name: "notify[digest]", hint: "A summary every Monday." %>
  <%= lc_checkbox "Product news", name: "notify[news]", disabled: true %>
<% end %>
```

Copy from an element: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/copy_button.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related, class: "w-full max-w-md" do %>
  <%= lc_field label: "Share link", id: "my-component-link" do |field| %>
    <%= lc_input value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", **field %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_copy_button "Copy current link", source: "my-component-link", copied_label: "Link copied", class: "w-full" %>
  <%= lc_text "Edit the link, then copy it. The button reads the current value each time.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
<% end %>
```

Empty state: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/empty_state.html

```erb
<%= lc_empty_state class: "w-full" do %>
  <%= lc_icon_badge shape: :circle, tone: :primary, icon: "folder-plus", size: :lg%>
  <%= lc_stack gap: :tight, class: "max-w-xs" do %>
    <%= lc_heading "No projects yet", level: 3, size: :subheading %>
    <%= lc_text "Create a project to get started.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_button "Create project" %>
<% end %>
```

Focus a field: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/kbd.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related, class: "w-full max-w-sm" do %>
  <%= lc_field label: "Filter projects", id: "my-component-filter" do |field| %>
    <%= lc_input name: "q", type: :search, placeholder: "Press / to filter", data: lc_shortcut_data("/"), **field %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_text size: :small, tone: :muted do %>
    Press <%= lc_kbd "/" %> to filter, then <%= lc_kbd "escape" %> to clear.
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

Tones: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/link.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related do %>
  <%= lc_text do %>Read the <%= lc_link "installation guide", "/installation.html" %> before you start.<% end %>
  <%= lc_text size: :small, tone: :muted do %>Questions? <%= lc_link "Contact support", "/components/link.html", tone: :muted %>.<% end %>
  <%= lc_text do %>See <%= lc_link "what's new", "/components/link.html", tone: :primary %> in this release.<% end %>
<% end %>
```

Skip link: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/skip_link.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related, class: "items-center" do %>
  <%= lc_text "Press Tab on this page: the skip link is the first thing to receive focus.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
  <%= lc_skip_link "#examples", class: "not-sr-only static" %>
<% end %>
```

Switches: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/switch.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related do %>
  <%= lc_switch "Public project", name: "project[public]", checked: true %>
  <%= lc_switch "Allow comments", name: "project[comments]", hint: "Members can comment on pages." %>
<% end %>
```

## lc_inline

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html#lc_inline

```ruby
lc_inline(gap: :related, **attributes, &block)
```

Page rhythm: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :section, class: "w-full max-w-xl" do %>

    <%= lc_card do %>

        <%= lc_text "Dinner with friends" %>
        <%= lc_text "¥8,400", class: "shrink-0 tabular-nums" %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= lc_card do %>
      <%= lc_text "Train tickets" %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_section title: "Members" do %>
    <%= lc_card do %>
      <%= lc_inline do %>
        <%= lc_avatar "AK", class: "bg-primary" %>
        <%= lc_stack gap: :tight do %>
          <%= lc_text "Alex Kim" %>

<% end %>
```

Filters: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/toggle.html

```erb
<%= lc_inline role: "group", aria: { label: "Topics" } do %>
  <%= lc_toggle "Design", active: true %>
  <%= lc_toggle "Writing" %>
  <%= lc_toggle "Research" %>
<% end %>
```

Navigation: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/toggle.html

```erb
<%= lc_inline do %>
  <%= lc_button_link_to "All projects", "/components/toggle.html", variant: :outline, size: :sm, aria: { current: "page" }, class: "bg-primary-soft border-primary text-primary" %>
  <%= lc_button_link_to "Archived", "/components/badge.html", variant: :outline, size: :sm %>
<% end %>
```

Tooltips: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/tooltip.html

```erb
<%= lc_inline gap: :content do %>
  <%= lc_tooltip "Copy a link to this page", id: "my-component-copy-tip" do |tip| %>
    <%= lc_icon_button "Copy link", icon: "link", **tip %>
  <% end %>
```

```erb
    <li>Choose a place to stay.</li>
    <li>Set aside time for a slow morning.</li>
    <li>Leave an afternoon open.</li>
  </ul>
```

## lc_prose

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html#lc_prose

```ruby
lc_prose(**attributes, &block)
```

Reading content: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_prose do %>
  <h2>Make room for the trip</h2>
  <p>A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.</p>
  <p>Start with <strong>one clear decision</strong>, name the plan <code>kyoto-weekend</code>, then <a href="#reading-next">choose what comes next</a>.</p>
  <ul>
    <li>Choose a place to stay.</li>
    <li>Set aside time for a slow morning.</li>
    <li>Leave an afternoon open.</li>
  </ul>
  <blockquote><p>The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.</p></blockquote>
  <h3 id="reading-next">Ready to begin?</h3>
  <p>Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.</p>
  <div class="not-prose mt-5">
    <%= lc_button "Create a plan" %>
  </div>
<% end %>
```

Japanese reading: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/foundations.html

```erb
<%= lc_prose lang: "ja" do %>
  <h2>旅の計画に、少しの余白を。</h2>
  <p>みんなで予定を考えるときは、大切なことから順番に決めていきましょう。読みやすい行間と段落の間隔が、長い文章をたどる手助けになります。</p>
  <h3>最初に決めておきたいこと</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>集合する場所と時間</li>
    <li>みんなで分ける費用</li>
    <li>自由に過ごす時間</li>
  </ul>
  <p>予定が変わったら、<a href="#reading-japanese-note">グループにひとこと</a>。少しの共有で、旅がもっと気軽になります。</p>
  <blockquote id="reading-japanese-note"><p>何もしない時間も、旅の楽しみのひとつです。</p></blockquote>
<% end %>
```

```erb
    <%= lc_alert "Choose a unique project name.", tone: :destructive %>
    <%= lc_field label: "Project name", id: "my-component-name", error: "This name is already taken." do |field| %>
      <%= lc_input name: "project[name]", value: "Design system", **field %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
```

```erb
<%= lc_stack gap: :related, class: "w-full max-w-md" do %>
  <%= lc_field label: "Share link", id: "my-component-link" do |field| %>
    <%= lc_input value: "https://ui.lostcoords.com", **field %>
  <% end %>

<% end %>
```

## lc_toggle_group

https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/toggle_group.html#lc_toggle_group

```ruby
lc_toggle_group(label:, name: nil, value: nil, **attributes, &block)
```

Mutually exclusive choices: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/toggle_group.html

```erb
<%= lc_toggle_group label: "View", name: "view", value: "month" do %>
  <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Week", value: "week" %>
  <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Month", value: "month", selected: true %>
  <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Year", value: "year" %>
<% end %>
```

Form values and reset: https://ui.lostcoords.com/components/toggle_group.html

```erb
<form class="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
  <%= lc_toggle_group label: "Billing", name: "billing", value: "monthly" do %>
    <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Monthly", value: "monthly", selected: true %>
    <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Annual", value: "annual" %>
    <%= lc_toggle_group_item "Custom", value: "custom", disabled: true %>
  <% end %>
  <%= lc_button "Reset", type: :reset, variant: :ghost, size: :sm %>
</form>
```

## Blocks

Docs-only composition examples: https://ui.lostcoords.com/blocks.html
Copy and adapt the example files. Blocks are not importable library components.

### Application header

A glass header with navigation, an account menu and room for your brand.
https://ui.lostcoords.com/blocks/application_header.html

Replace the sample brand, links and account actions with your application's content.

Keep navigation destinations as links and account actions in the menu. The header's layout and scroll behavior live in the example files.

app/views/shared/_application_header.html.erb

```erb
<%# locals: (brand:, home: "/", home_label:, links: [], label: "Main", width: "max-w-5xl", navigation_class: "sm:flex") %>
<%# links: [[label, url, current], …]. The block's content renders the actions at the end of the bar. %>
<header class="header-example sticky top-0 z-sticky px-3 pt-3 pb-4 sm:px-6" data-controller="blocks-header" data-action="scroll@window->blocks-header#scroll">
  <div class="relative isolate mx-auto flex min-h-16 <%= width %> items-center gap-related px-3 py-2 sm:gap-content sm:px-5">
    <span class="header-example__glass <%= lc_glass_class(thick: true, extra: "pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10") %>" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <a href="<%= home %>" class="flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-related pe-2 font-semibold tracking-tight no-underline text-inherit" aria-label="<%= home_label %>"><%= brand %></a>
    <% if links.any? %>
      <nav class="hidden items-center gap-tight <%= navigation_class %>" aria-label="<%= label %>">
        <% links.each do |text, url, current| %>
          <%= lc_button_link_to text, url, variant: :ghost, size: :sm, class: "aria-[current=page]:bg-accent", aria: { current: ("page" if current) } %>
        <% end %>
      </nav>
    <% end %>
    <div class="ms-auto flex items-center gap-related"><%= yield %></div>
  </div>
</header>
```

app/assets/stylesheets/application_header.css

```css
}
```

app/javascript/controllers/blocks_header_controller.js

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"

export default class extends Controller {
  connect() {
    this.scroll()
  }

  scroll() {
    this.element.toggleAttribute("data-scrolled", window.scrollY > 8)
  }
}
```

### Documentation layout

A sidebar, page content and an "On this page" list, with a collapsible menu on phones.
https://ui.lostcoords.com/blocks/docs_shell.html

Render it as a layout: pass the sidebar and contents lists as locals and the page as the block. This documentation site uses it for every guide and component page.

Mark the current page with current: true so the sidebar sets aria-current. The contents list appears from the xl breakpoint.

app/views/shared/_docs_shell.html.erb

```erb
<%# locals: (navigation:, contents: nil, menu_label: "Menu", width: nil) %>
<%# navigation: the sidebar, usually lc_nav_list. contents: an optional "On this page" list for wide screens. %>
<div class="docs-shell mx-auto flex max-w-360 gap-10 px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-10">
  <aside tabindex="0" aria-label="Documentation sidebar" class="docs-shell__sidebar sticky top-20 hidden h-[calc(100dvh-5rem)] w-52 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto py-8 pe-4 lg:block">
    <%= navigation %>
  </aside>
  <main id="main" class="isolate min-w-0 flex-1 py-5 lg:py-10 <%= width %>">
    <details class="group/nav relative z-raised rounded-2xl lc-squircle bg-muted lg:hidden">
      <summary class="flex min-h-12 cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between gap-content px-4 text-label [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden"><%= menu_label %><%= lc_icon "chevron-down", options: { class: "size-4 transition-transform group-open/nav:rotate-180", "aria-hidden": true } %></summary>
      <div class="max-h-[60dvh] overflow-y-auto p-3 pt-0"><%= navigation %></div>
    </details>
    <div class="pt-6 lg:pt-0"><%= yield %></div>
  </main>
  <% if contents %>
    <aside class="sticky top-20 hidden h-[calc(100dvh-5rem)] w-40 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto py-12 ps-4 xl:block"><%= contents %></aside>
  <% end %>
</div>
```

app/assets/stylesheets/docs_shell.css

app/javascript/controllers/blocks_mobile_navigation_controller.js

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"

export default class extends Controller {
  static targets = ["link", "panel", "indicator", "status", "projects", "notes", "draft"]

  connect() {
    this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.placeIndicator())
    this.linkTargets.forEach((link) => this.resizeObserver.observe(link))
    this.onViewportResize = () => this.keyboard()
    window.visualViewport?.addEventListener("resize", this.onViewportResize)
    this.placeIndicator()
  }

  disconnect() {
    this.resizeObserver.disconnect()
    window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener("resize", this.onViewportResize)
  }

  select(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    this.show(event.currentTarget.hash.slice(1))
  }

  home(event) {
    event.preventDefault()
    this.show("projects")
  }

  show(id) {
    for (const link of this.linkTargets) {
      if (link.hash === `#${id}`) link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page")
      else link.removeAttribute("aria-current")
    }
    for (const panel of this.panelTargets) panel.hidden = panel.id !== id
    this.placeIndicator()
  }

  placeIndicator() {
    const active = this.linkTargets.find((link) => link.getAttribute("aria-current") === "page")
    this.indicatorTarget.style.translate = `${active.offsetLeft}px 0`
    this.indicatorTarget.style.width = `${active.offsetWidth}px`
  }

  add({ params: { destination } }) {
    const draft = this.draftTarget.content.cloneNode(true)
    const title = destination === "projects" ? "Untitled project" : "A new thought"
    draft.querySelector("[data-draft-title]").textContent = title
    const list = destination === "projects" ? this.projectsTarget : this.notesTarget
    list.prepend(draft)
    this.show(destination)
    this.statusTarget.textContent = `${title} added. Your next idea starts here.`
  }

  keyboard() {
    const typing = document.activeElement?.matches("input, textarea, [contenteditable=true]")
    const inset = window.innerHeight - (window.visualViewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight)
    this.element.toggleAttribute("data-keyboard", typing && inset > 150)
  }
}
```

### Global search

A search trigger that expands into a focused overlay with grouped results.
https://ui.lostcoords.com/blocks/global_search.html

This example filters sample results in the browser so it also works on the static documentation site.

Replace the sample results with your own data or a Turbo Frame endpoint. Keep permissions, ranking and fetching in your application.

app/views/shared/_global_search.html.erb

```erb

  collections = {

          <% end %>

    <div class="search-example__stack" data-search-dismiss>
      <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
        <label class="<%= lc_glass_class(extra: "flex min-h-14 min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-text items-center gap-3 ps-5 pe-2 sm:min-h-16") %>" data-blocks-search-target="bar">
          <%= lc_icon "magnifying-glass", options: { class: "size-6 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground", "aria-hidden": true } %>

          <%= lc_icon_button "Clear search", icon: "x-circle", size: :sm, hidden: true, data: { blocks_search_target: "clear", action: "blocks-search#clear" } %>

        </label>
        <%= lc_button "Cancel", variant: :ghost, size: :sm, data: { action: "blocks-search#close" } %>

            <h2 class="px-3 pb-2 font-mono text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground"><%= name %></h2>
            <% items.each do |item| %>
              <button type="button" class="search-example__result flex min-h-16 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-start" data-blocks-search-target="result" data-action="blocks-search#select" data-title="<%= item[:title] %>" data-detail="<%= item[:detail] %>" data-search="<%= item[:words] %>">
                <%= lc_icon_badge icon: item[:icon] %>
                <span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5"><span class="truncate text-sm font-semibold"><%= item[:title] %></span><span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground"><%= item[:meta] %></span></span>
                <%= lc_icon "arrow-up-left", options: { class: "size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground", "aria-hidden": true } %>
              </button>
            <% end %>
          </section>
        <% end %>
        <div class="px-5 py-10 text-center" data-blocks-search-target="empty" hidden>
          <p class="font-semibold">Nothing here just yet.</p><p class="pt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Try a project, a person, or a different word.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</div>
```

app/javascript/controllers/blocks_search_controller.js

```javascript
import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"
import { registerDialog } from "lostcoords/ui/helpers/dialog"
import { prefersReducedMotion } from "lostcoords/ui/helpers/viewport"

export default class extends Controller {
  static targets = [
    "dialog",
    "trigger",
    "input",
    "bar",
    "results",
    "result",
    "group",
    "empty",
    "clear",
    "summary",
    "selectionTitle",
    "selectionDetail",
    "selectionStatus",
  ]

  // ⌘K / Ctrl+K comes from lc-shortcut: it presses the trigger while search is
  // closed and refocuses the field while it is open.
  connect() {
    this.animations = []
  }

  disconnect() {
    this.returnFocus = null
    this.reset()
  }

  open() {
    if (this.closing) return
    if (this.dialogTarget.open) return this.inputTarget.focus()
    this.returnFocus =
      document.activeElement === document.body ? this.triggerTarget : document.activeElement
    this.filter()
    this.dialogTarget.showModal()
    this.unregisterDialog = registerDialog(this.dialogTarget, { close: () => this.close() })
    this.inputTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    this.animate()
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.dialogTarget.open || this.closing) return
    this.closing = true
    this.animate({ reverse: true })
    Promise.allSettled(this.animations.map((animation) => animation.finished)).then(() =>
      this.reset(),
    )
  }

  reset() {
    this.animations.forEach((animation) => animation.cancel())
    this.animations = []
    this.dialogTarget.close()
    this.unregisterDialog?.()
    this.unregisterDialog = null
    this.closing = false
  }

  closed() {
    this.reset()
    this.returnFocus?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    this.returnFocus = null
  }

  dismiss(event) {
    if (event.target.hasAttribute("data-search-dismiss")) this.close()
  }

  clear() {
    this.inputTarget.value = ""
    this.filter()
    this.inputTarget.focus()
  }

  filter(event) {
    if (event?.isComposing) return
    const query = this.inputTarget.value.normalize("NFKC").trim().toLowerCase()
    const words = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    let count = 0
    for (const result of this.resultTargets) {
      result.hidden = !words.every((word) => result.dataset.search.includes(word))
      if (!result.hidden) count++
    }
    for (const group of this.groupTargets) {
      group.hidden = !group.querySelector("[data-blocks-search-target=result]:not([hidden])")
    }
    this.clearTarget.hidden = !this.inputTarget.value
    this.emptyTarget.hidden = count > 0
    this.summaryTarget.textContent = query
      ? `${count} ${count === 1 ? "result" : "results"} for “${this.inputTarget.value.trim()}”`
      : "Start with something recent"
  }

  navigate(event) {
    if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) return
    const results = this.resultTargets.filter((result) => !result.hidden)
    const items = [this.inputTarget, ...results]
    const index = items.indexOf(document.activeElement)
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault()
      const step = event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1
      items[Math.min(Math.max(index + step, 0), items.length - 1)].focus()
    } else if (event.key === "Enter" && document.activeElement === this.inputTarget) {
      event.preventDefault()
      results[0]?.click()
    }
  }

  select(event) {
    this.showSelection(event.currentTarget.dataset)
    this.close()
  }

  explore(event) {
    this.showSelection(event.currentTarget.dataset)
  }

  showSelection({ title, detail }) {
    this.selectionTitleTarget.textContent = title
    this.selectionDetailTarget.textContent = detail
    this.selectionStatusTarget.textContent = `Opened ${title}.`
  }

  animate({ reverse = false } = {}) {
    this.animations.forEach((animation) => animation.cancel())
    this.animations = []
    if (prefersReducedMotion()) return
    const from = this.triggerTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const to = this.barTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const insetY = Math.max((to.height - from.height) / 2, 0)
    const shiftY = from.top + from.height / 2 - (to.top + to.height / 2)
    const timing = {
      duration: reverse ? 200 : 360,
      easing: "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
      direction: reverse ? "reverse" : "normal",
      fill: "both",
    }
    this.animations = [
      this.barTarget.animate(
        [
          {
            clipPath: `inset(${insetY}px ${to.right - from.right}px ${insetY}px ${from.left - to.left}px round 999px)`,
            translate: `0 ${shiftY}px`,
          },
          { clipPath: "inset(-1rem round 999px)", translate: "0 0" },
        ],
        timing,
      ),
      this.resultsTarget.animate(
        [
          { opacity: 0, translate: "0 -0.5rem" },
          { opacity: 1, translate: "0 0" },
        ],
        timing,
      ),
    ]
  }
}
```

## Advanced styles

Class helpers style custom markup; the application owns its behavior.
Glass surfaces use lc_glass_class; lc_tw merges utility classes. Read https://github.com/lostcoords/ui#advanced-style-composition.

- `lc_icon_badge_class(size: :md, shape: :square, tone: :neutral, extra: nil)`
- `lc_avatar_class(size: :md, ink: false, linked: false, extra: nil)`
- `lc_avatar_stack_class(compact: false, extra: nil)`
- `lc_avatar_stack_row_class(extra: nil)`
- `lc_badge_class(tone: :neutral, extra: nil)`
- `lc_toggle_class(active: false, ghost: false, size: :md, extra: nil)`
- `lc_button_class(variant: :primary, size: :md, block: false, extra: nil)`
- `lc_icon_button_class(shape: :square, size: :md, extra: nil)`
- `lc_card_class(interactive: false, padding: :md, extra: nil)`
- `lc_choice_label_class(card: false, extra: nil)`
- `lc_checkbox_class(extra: nil)`
- `lc_radio_class(extra: nil)`
- `lc_switch_class(extra: nil)`

- `lc_emoji_picker_groups`
